en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic Italian town square surrounded by multi‑story buildings with tiled roofs, arcades at street level, and a central fountain. A church with a bell tower (Chiesa di S. Maria Maggiore) and another tower rise above the rooftops, with large mountains in the background. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Piazza Vittorio Emanuele III in Trento, looking toward La Paganella.
